declaration.intent: Compute all valid numeric region-quarter sums, quarter totals, and annual total while retaining duplicate records.

args.sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT CASE WHEN trim(region) = '' OR region IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE region END AS region, CASE WHEN CAST(substr(service_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN CAST(substr(service_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN CAST(substr(service_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3' WHEN CAST(substr(service_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN 'Q4' END AS quarter, CAST(amount AS REAL) AS amt FROM data WHERE trim(amount) <> '' AND amount NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.-]*'), totals AS (SELECT region, quarter, SUM(amt) AS total FROM valid GROUP BY region, quarter), qt AS (SELECT quarter, SUM(amt) AS total FROM valid GROUP BY quarter) SELECT 'REGION' AS kind, region || '|' || quarter AS label, total FROM totals UNION ALL SELECT 'QUARTER', quarter, total FROM qt UNION ALL SELECT 'ANNUAL', 'ANNUAL', SUM(amt) FROM valid ORDER BY kind, label
